== 0. 环境 ==
redis_version:8.10.2
os:Darwin 24.6.0 arm64
arch_bits:64
process_id:45931
PING: PONG

== 1. 清空本节实例（16392 只有本节的 key）==
OK

== 2. 可抄之一：单条写入（收件箱 = ZSET，score 用毫秒时间戳，member = feed:+12 位补零 id）==
+ redis-cli -p 16392 ZADD inbox:u1001 1730000000000 feed:000000009001
1
+ redis-cli -p 16392 ZADD inbox:u1001 1730000000123 feed:000000009002
1
+ redis-cli -p 16392 ZADD inbox:u1001 1730000000123 feed:000000009003
1
+ set +x
ZCARD inbox:u1001 -> 3
同分（1730000000123）两条 member：feed:000000009002 < feed:000000009003，ZREVRANGE 降序先出 9003
feed:000000009003
1730000000123
feed:000000009002
1730000000123
feed:000000009001
1730000000000

== 3. 灌入两套基线（各 3000 条，每 3 条共用一个 score）==
   inbox:u1001    member = feed:012d（生产格式，字符串序 = 数值序）
   inbox:u1001raw member = feed:%d（对照，字符串序 != 数值序）
1
errors: 0, replies: 6000
ZCARD inbox:u1001    -> 3000
ZCARD inbox:u1001raw -> 3000

== 4. 可抄之二：真实游标翻页（ZREVRANGEBYSCORE + 同分 id 兜底）==
-- 第 1 页：score 从 +inf 往下取 20 条
+ redis-cli -p 16392 ZREVRANGEBYSCORE inbox:u1001 +inf -inf WITHSCORES LIMIT 0 20
feed:000000003000
1700001000000
feed:000000002999
1700000999000

1700000994000

+ set +x
-- 第 1 页末条 = (score, member)，作为下一页游标
feed:000000002981
1700000993000

-- 错误写法：下一页直接 (score 排掉整个同分组，同分剩余成员一起丢
   第 20 名的 score = 1700000993000
feed:000000002978
1700000992000
feed:000000002977
1700000992000
feed:000000002976
1700000992000
feed:000000002975
1700000991000

-- 正确写法：先把同一 score 组里 member < 游标的补出来，再从更小 score 取
feed:000000002981
1700000993000
feed:000000002980
1700000993000
feed:000000002979
1700000993000

== 5. redis-cli 侧单命令耗时（CONFIG RESETSTAT + INFO commandstats，服务端口径）==
cmdstat_zrevrangebyscore:calls=4000,usec=4578,usec_per_call=1.14,rejected_calls=0,failed_calls=0

LOAD_DONE
